text.ur: اردو میں 'دو دن سے' اور 'پیر سے' دونوں میں 'سے' ہے۔ انگریزی میں: مدت کے لیے 'for' (for two days) اور شروع ہونے کے وقت کے لیے 'since' (since Monday)۔ 'since two days' غلط ہے۔
text.roman: Urdu mein 'do din se' aur 'peer se' dono mein 'se' hai. Angrezi mein: muddat ke liye 'for' (for two days) aur shuru hone ke waqt ke liye 'since' (since Monday). 'since two days' ghalat hai.

examples.en: I have had a fever for two days.
examples.ur: مجھے دو دن سے بخار ہے۔
examples.roman: Mujhe do din se bukhaar hai.

examples.en: I have had a cough since Monday.

examples.ur: مجھے ڈاکٹر سے ملنے کا وقت چاہیے۔
examples.roman: Mujhe doctor se milne ka waqt chahiye.

q.ur: مجھے ڈاکٹر سے ملنے کا وقت چاہیے
q.roman: Mujhe doctor se milne ka waqt chahiye

q.en: I have had a fever ___ three days.
I have had a cough ___ Monday.

why.ur: 'Monday' شروع ہونے کا دن ہے، اس لیے 'since'۔
why.roman: 'Monday' shuru hone ka din hai, is liye 'since'.

exercises.sentence: I am sick since two days.
exercises.fixed: I have been sick for two days.

why.ur: مدت کے ساتھ 'for': for two days۔
why.roman: Muddat ke saath 'for': for two days.

exercises.say: How long have you had this pain?

q.ur: کیا مجھے دوا کی ضرورت ہے؟
q.roman: Kya mujhe dawa ki zaroorat hai?

exercises.say: Take this medicine twice a day.
options: Take this medicine twice a day.
Take this medicine twice a week.

exercises.say: I would like to make an appointment, please.

meaning.ur: میں ملاقات کا وقت لینا چاہتا ہوں۔
meaning.roman: Main mulaqaat ka waqt lena chahta hoon.
